meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手可用你扫码链接的手机号收发 Signal 消息。它支持 Markdown、引用回复、私聊打字提示,也处理你发给自己的 Note to Self。语音消息默认不转写,只显示占位符;尚不支持发文件附件、编辑或删除消息。
howto.when: 当你说“加 Signal 渠道”“让我的 Signal 账号能收发消息”等请求时进入安装流程;通常需用手机扫码完成设备链接后才生效。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 加上 Signal 渠道
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并复制适配器与注册代码

say.text: 让我的 Signal 账号能收发消息
say.note: 启动设备链接,显示二维码让你用手机扫

say.text: 把 Signal 接到我现有的手机号上
say.note: 助手以该号码收发,无需注册新号

howto.what_en: Adds Signal as a secondary device: the assistant sends/receives as the scanned number. Markdown, quoted replies, DM typing, Note to Self supported. Voice attachments become placeholders, not transcribed; no files/edits/deletes yet.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Signal channel or to let your Signal number send/receive messages; enters install, QR link, and wiring flow.

say_en.text: Add the Signal channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and copies the adapter.

say_en.text: Let my Signal account send and receive messages.
say_en.note: Starts device-link and shows a scannable QR code.

say_en.text: Connect Signal to my existing phone number.
say_en.note: Acts as that number; no new number is needed.
